seccion.cierre: Your team keeps the judgement. Comando removes the load.
seccion.eyebrow: THIS IS HOW THE DAY CHANGES
seccion.titulo: Your team loses hours in the CRM instead of selling.

evidencias.speed: Answering a lead in under 5 minutes multiplies the odds of qualifying it by 21 (Lead Response Management Study).
evidencias.toques: 80 % of sales need 5 or more contacts; 44 % of reps give up after the first one (Brevet Group).
evidencias.cotizacion: Following up between day 3 and day 5 after a quote doubles the close rate.
evidencias.noshow: Confirming the appointment and reminding 24 h and 2 h before cuts no-shows by 40 % to 70 %.
evidencias.carrito: Cart recovery over WhatsApp reaches 18-23 % against roughly 8 % by email.
evidencias.estancados: A deal past 1.5 times the average cycle has less than half the chance of closing.

casos.titulo: I close more without living in the CRM

comandos.u: Which leads came in last night from the portal and who has not touched them?
comandos.r: 6 new leads from the portals; 2 with no owner for 9 hours. Shall I take them for you or split them?

comandos.u: For the ones who did not answer the quote, remind me on day 3, 5 and 7 with the message ready.
comandos.r: Done. 4 are due today: here is the first, the Rojas family, unit 402 — “Hi Carla, I sent you the quote for 402 on Monday…”. Tap to send it.

comandos.u: Move the Rojas 402 to Negotiation and note that they asked for 30 days for the deposit.
comandos.r: Done in HubSpot: stage Negotiation, note saved. Shall I create the task to call on the 15th to confirm the deposit?

casos.resultado: No follow-up forgotten. Zero minutes typing into the CRM.
casos.proactivo: ☀️ Good morning. 6 leads came in from the portals last night and 2 still have no owner. On top of that, 4 quotes hit 3 days with no reply. Answer SEE for the list.

comandos.u: Which patients got a quote this week and have not replied?
comandos.r: 7 quotes with no reply: 3 for braces, 4 for implants. The oldest is Marta Pérez (6 days).

comandos.u: Prepare the message for Marta reminding her the quote expires on Friday.
comandos.r: “Hi Marta, this is Diego from Clínica Sonríe. Your braces quote is valid until Friday; if you like we can go over it here in 10 minutes.” Tap to send it.

comandos.u: Mark Luis Ávila's quote as accepted and create me the task to book the first session.
comandos.r: Quote accepted in the CRM and task created for today. Shall I offer Tuesday or Thursday?

casos.resultado: Quotes close while they still matter.
casos.proactivo: ⏰ 7 quotes from this week still have no reply; Marta Pérez's (braces) expires on Friday. Answer SEE and I will hand you the messages ready.

comandos.u: Which carts over $200 were abandoned today?
comandos.r: 5 carts: the largest is Andrea Gómez's ($480, sneakers and a jacket). None completed payment.

comandos.u: Prepare the message for Andrea with the payment link and 5 % off.
comandos.r: Coupon ANDREA5 created in Shopify. “Hi Andrea, you left your sneakers and the jacket in the cart; here is the link with an extra 5 %…”. Tap to send it.

comandos.u: Mark order 1042 as delivered and note that the customer asked for an invoice.
comandos.r: Order 1042 delivered and note saved. Tomorrow I will leave you the message ready to ask for the review.

casos.resultado: Every abandoned cart gets a second chance.
casos.proactivo: 🛒 5 carts over $200 were abandoned today; the largest is Andrea Gómez's ($480). Answer SEE and I will leave the recovery messages ready.

comandos.u: Split the north-zone leads between Ana and Luis; if nobody takes them within 1 hour, tell me.
comandos.r: 11 leads assigned (6 Ana, 5 Luis). I will tell you in an hour about any still with no activity.

comandos.u: How many viewings did we close this month compared with last month?
comandos.r: August: 31 % of viewings ended in a deposit against 24 % in July. Up 7 points.

casos.resultado: One WhatsApp at the end of the day beats three dashboards.
casos.proactivo: 📊 Monday 8:00 · 38 active deals, 6 stalled more than 10 days (4 of them Luis's). Answer SEE for the breakdown by rep.

casos.titulo: Know which ad fills the gym

comandos.u: Every Monday at 8, send me leads by channel, trials booked and memberships closed by branch.
comandos.r: Scheduled. Every Monday at 8:00 you get leads by channel, trials and memberships by branch, with each one's conversion rate.

comandos.u: If a lead from the ad goes 30 minutes without a call, alert the branch advisor and me.
comandos.r: Rule created: lead with no contact in 30 minutes → alert to the branch advisor, copy to you. Applies to Meta and Google leads.

comandos.u: How much did each new membership cost us per channel this month?
comandos.r: Meta: $38 per membership (19 closed). Google: $61 (7 closed). Referrals: $0 (6). Meta brings 60% of sign-ups with 55% of the spend.

casos.resultado: You decide where to put the budget with today's numbers.
casos.proactivo: 📊 Monday 8:00 · 86 leads last week (Meta 61, Google 25), 23 trials booked, 9 new memberships. North branch converts at 6%; Downtown, at 14%. Reply VIEW for the details.

comandos.r: Done. 4 are due today: here's the first, Andrea Mora: "Hi Andrea, your plan expires on the 18th. Renew early and the month drops to $29 instead of $35…". Tap to send.

casos.resultado: Fewer silent cancellations. Every expiry gets a message in time.
casos.proactivo: ⏰ 27 memberships expire in the next 7 days; 12 members haven't come in for 3 weeks. Reply VIEW and I'll send you the ready-made messages.
